name: Interpolation and Approximation
description:
Interpolation: Polynomial Interpolation; The General Problem of Finite Interpolation; Systems Possessing Interpolation Property-Hermite Interpolation, Lagrange Interpolation, Chebyshev Interpolation, Lidstone Interpolation, Trigonometric Interpolation; Representation Theorems-Lagrange and Newton Formulae; Cauchy Reminder for Polynomial Interpolation; Peano theorem and Its Consequence; The inequalities of Markov and Bernstein; Runge Phenomena,; Cubic Splines, Holladay Functional, Energy Minimisation. 
Approximation: Weierstrass Approximation Theorem; Bernstein Polynomials; Approximation by Interpolation (Fejer Proof); Generalizations of Weierstrass Approximation Theorem - Korovkin's Theorem, The Stone-Weierstrass Theorem, Muntz theorem; Concept of Best Approximation in a Normed linear space, Existence and Uniqueness of the Best Approximation;; Inner Product Spaces and Least Square Approximations; Fourier Expansion;; Gram matrices and Determinants; Orthogonal Polynomials.
An Invitation to Fractal Interpolation and Approximation: Iterated Function Systems, Fractal Interpolation, alpha-Fractal Functions and Fractal Approximation.
